expect.title: Not Mentioned in the Itinerary
expect.body: Things not mentioned in the itinerary must be paid by customers, e.g. shower room, shopping etc.

expect.title: Prepare Cash
expect.body: Prepare cash if you plan to shop at Sabah Town Market. Cards and QR are not available at some shops and street stalls.

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Private transport will be used for all activity transfers.

expect.title: Triple Room Bed
expect.body: Triple sharing room with 1 single bed will be provided based on availability. An extra bed will be added if no triple bed is available in the travel period.

expect.title: Meals
expect.body: Meals provided during the trip (breakfast) will be local food. Other meals (lunch & dinner) can be decided during the trip with the driver.

expect.title: For Non Malaysian
expect.body: Entrance fees, tourism tax & surcharge for non-Malaysians can be paid during the trip.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Price for single supplement is additional RM300 per person.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if the booking is made less than 45 days before departure.
All itinerary, flight, price or quotation is subject to change.
The itinerary during the trip is subject to change due to weather, traffic, safety and similar factors.
Final itinerary and accommodation arrangements will be shared 14 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting flights.
Any free activity is non-exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash if the client does not join, or due to availability and weather conditions.
Entrance fees, tourism tax & surcharge for non-Malaysians are normally around RM170 - RM370 per person.

deposit.text: prior to departure for full payment
